description: Plan a scenic drive with the Byway engine: real verified stops, honest timing, official scenic byways. Origin and destination are place names — the tool resolves each to the closest matching real place. budget_min is the whole time window (driving plus stops, default 240): a long drive needs a budget comfortably above its direct drive time or there is no slack to spend on stops. Requires a connected Byway account (OAuth sign-in). Set save=true to save the trip to your account.

budget_min.description: Total minutes for the whole trip, driving plus stops (30-960, default 240). Set well above the direct drive time to make room for stops.

depart_at.description: Departure time, ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. 2026-08-20T09:00:00-04:00). Defaults to now; must be within 14 days — hours and weather verdicts are real only inside the forecast horizon.

destination.description: Where the drive ends (city or place name)

save.description: Save the trip to the account

name: plan_drive
title: Plan a byway
